name: VRM_SOURCE_DOC_LINES
description: This object stores the document lines from the upstream applications. The document lines are used for VSOE price calculation and also for creating multiple element arrangements in the Revenue Management application

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: System-generated unique key for source document line. Examples of source document line include sales order line, invoice line, project line, and service contract line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Source document identifier of line. Foreign key to DOCUMENT_ID in VRM_SOURCE_DOCUMENTS.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Oracle Application identifier of source document. Foreign key to FND applications table. For example, 222 for Receivables invoices, or users can optionally use -1.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Source document type identifier of various source systems which integrate with revenue management.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_INT_1
columns.description: First numeric column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_INT_2
columns.description: Second numeric column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_INT_3
columns.description: Third numeric column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_INT_4
columns.description: Fourth numeric column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_INT_5
columns.description: Fifth numeric column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_CHAR_1
columns.description: First character column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_CHAR_2
columns.description: Second character column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_ID_INT_1
columns.description: First numeric column of the key that identifies source document in source application.

columns.name: DOC_ID_INT_2
columns.description: Second numeric column of the key that identifies source document in source application.

columns.name: DOC_ID_INT_3
columns.description: Third numeric column of the key that identifies source document in source application.

columns.name: DOC_ID_INT_4
columns.description: Fourth numeric column of the key that identifies source document in source application.

columns.name: DOC_ID_INT_5
columns.description: Fifth numeric column of the key that identifies source document in source application.

columns.name: DOC_ID_CHAR_1
columns.description: First character column of the key that identifies source document in source application.

columns.name: DOC_ID_CHAR_2
columns.description: Second character column of the key that identifies source document in source application.

columns.name: DOC_ID_CHAR_3
columns.description: Third character column of the key that identifies source document in source application.

columns.name: DOC_ID_CHAR_5

columns.name: DOCUMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date of source document, such as book date for sales order, or invoice date for invoice.

columns.name: LINE_TYPE
columns.description: Source document line type for a project line. Possible values are ORIGINAL for initial baselined approved version, and REVISION for subsequent changes including changes to the revenue budget or for project status changed to closed.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.description: Item inventory organization identifier of inventory item on source document line.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.description: Inventory item identifier on source document line. For a single source line, pass values in either ITEM_ID or MEMO_LINE_SEQ_ID columns, but not both.

columns.name: ITEM_NUMBER
columns.description: Inventory item numeric identifier on source document line.

columns.name: ITEM_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of inventory item on source document line.

columns.name: MEMO_LINE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: Unit of measure of inventory item or memo line on source document line.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Quantity of inventory item or memo line on source document line.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
columns.description: Selling price per unit of measure of the inventory item or memo line.

columns.name: UNIT_LIST_PRICE
columns.description: List price per unit of measure of the inventory item or memo line.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Percentage discount of unit selling price of inventory item or memo line on source document line. This column is used in FMV calculations and compliance processing.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PCT_BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Selling price per unit of measure of the inventory item or memo line as percentage of base price.

columns.name: UNIT_LIST_PCT_BASE_PRICE
columns.description: List price per unit of measure of the inventory item or memo line as percentage of base price.

columns.name: BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Base price per unit of measure of the inventory item or memo line.

columns.name: LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Extended line amount on source document line.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Account identifier of bill-to customer on source document.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Account identifier of ship-to customer on source document line.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party identifier of bill-to customer on source document.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_PARTY_NUM
columns.description: Party number of bill-to customer.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_PARTY_NAME
columns.description: Party name of bill-to customer on source document.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_NUM
columns.description: Account number of bill-to customer on source document.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_CUSTOMER_NUM
columns.description: Account number of ship-to customer on source document line.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Bill To Customer associated with source document.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_CUSTOMER_NAME
columns.description: Name of ship-to customer on source document line.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUST_SITE_NAME
columns.description: Site name of bill-to customer on source document.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_SITE_ID
columns.description: Site identifier of bill-to customer on source document.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_CUSTOMER_SITE_ID
columns.description: Site identifier of ship-to customer on source document line.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_CUST_SITE_NAME
columns.description: Site name of ship-to customer on source document line.

columns.name: BILL_TO_COUNTRY
columns.description: Country code of bill-to customer on source document.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_COUNTRY
columns.description: Country code of ship-to customer on source document line.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_STATE
columns.description: State code of bill-to customer on source document.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_COUNTY
columns.description: County of bill-to customer on source document.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_CITY
columns.description: City of bill-to customer on source document.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: Postal code of bill-to customer on source document.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUST_CLASSIFICATION
columns.description: Customer classification of bill-to customer on source document. Values are from the lookup CUSTOMER_CLASS. Value at source document line level takes precedence over value at source document level.

columns.name: MEMO_LINE_NAME
columns.description: Memo line name of source document line.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TERM_NAME
columns.description: Payment term name on source document.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_RULE_NAME
columns.description: Accounting rule name on the source document line.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_CODE
columns.description: Item inventory organization code of inventory item on source document line.

columns.name: ORIG_SYS_BILL_TO_CUST_SITE_REF
columns.description: Original application bill-to customer site reference on source document.

columns.name: ORIG_SYS_SHIP_TO_CUST_SITE_REF
columns.description: Original application ship-to customer site reference on source document.

columns.name: ORIG_SYS_BILL_TO_CUST_REF
columns.description: Original application bill-to customer reference on source document.

columns.name: ORIG_SYS_SHIP_TO_CUST_REF
columns.description: Original application ship-to customer reference on source document.
